description: At a port of entry the officer's determination is final and no appeal process exists. That single sentence is what converts a procedure into a power relationship.
energy_note: Decided in minutes, by one person, forever.

aspect: No reasons means nothing to argue with
description: Where reasons are not given, or are given as a category rather than a finding, there is no proposition to rebut. The applicant cannot demonstrate the decision was wrong because nothing was asserted.
energy_note: You cannot disprove a sentence nobody wrote.

description: A denial is not a formal inadmissibility but it remains in the system, and every later official sees it. One person's judgement on one morning becomes a permanent property of the file.
energy_note: A bad morning, attached to you permanently.

aspect: So the rational move is to withdraw rather than be refused
description: Practitioners advise that withdrawing the application and departing is generally preferable to accepting a formal refusal. The applicant is choosing to lose in order to avoid losing on the record - which is a decision made under duress and recorded as voluntary.
energy_note: Volunteering to fail, so the failure is not written down.

description: When the decision-maker is unreviewable, the applicant who questions, corrects or objects is taking a risk the compliant applicant is not. Over time the process trains everyone who passes through it, and the training is the point.
energy_note: Everyone learns to be agreeable, and calls it preparation.
